notes: IRS SOI 2023-2024 state and county migration data is NOT published as of 2026-10-08. The 2324 file names follow the 2022-23 page's own naming (countyinflow2223.csv etc.). Every one returns HTTP 404 with an IRS 'page not found' HTML body, while the same 2223 file names return 200 text/csv through the same proxy and User-Agent. So the 404s mean the files are missing, not that the network blocked them.
Per task instruction, stopped here: no 2023-24 flows computed. irs20_entry is empty on purpose and no numbers were invented.

2022-23 (released 19 Mar 2026 per SOI What's New) remains the latest edition. It is already in page_data.json irs20['2022-23'], built by an/irs_20yr.py from scratchpad/irsdec/countyinflow2223.csv (sha256 813ba2ef550c6a598a5121ccf98edcc79f61f1af69eb495bf44cd830b1586745) and scratchpad/irsout/countyoutflow2223.csv (sha256 364dba518f0db092515ccde03dda987815f6e54bcc8859640001e9185d4c106e).

Series-break caveat from the IRS landing page: 'Beginning with data for 2022-2023, SOI enhanced the matching process for individual income tax returns as a new series of information.' Comparing 2022-23 (and any future 2023-24) with 2021-22 and earlier mixes two matching methods.
Release cadence: 2022-23 was posted on 19 Mar 2026. If 2023-24 follows a similar lag, expect it around early-to-mid 2027. This is an inference, not an IRS-announced date.

For the eventual 2023-24 update, page_data irs20 entries look like {island: {in|out: {tot: [n1,n2,agi] from row 97/003 (row y?_statefips=97, countyfips=003 = 'Total Migration-Different State'), metros: {metro: [n1,n2,agi]} summed over county pairs with n1>=20 using the METRO county lists in an/irs_20yr.py, top: top 8 named US counties by n1 [name, state, n1, n2, agi]}}. Islands: 001 Hawaii Island, 003 Oahu, 007 Kauai, 009 Maui. Kalawao (005) is excluded. AGI is in $ thousands.
The linked 2223migrationdata.zip also returned 404 on HEAD today. That is irrelevant to the 2023-24 question but recorded here.
